aggregator.explanation: All six dimension agents prefer Lesson 1, most with high confidence. Lesson 1 is judged far more visually accurate, with the correct sorted array, target, indices, and binary-search state, while Lesson 2 contains garbled labels and inconsistent values. Lesson 1 also has a functioning quiz checkpoint, clearer narration, better timed visual cues, more complete conceptual explanation of low/high/mid updates and O(log n), and higher overall polish. Lesson 2 is consistently described as compressed, less synchronized, cluttered, and in some places defective or unverified. The unanimous weighted verdict strongly favors Lesson 1.
